headline: The new gift-card checkout can charge cents instead of the advertised dollar amount.
what_changed: Customers can now buy a gift card and receive a redemption code after payment.
The buyer is charged through the existing card payment service.
The product guide now mentions gift cards.

risks.title: Gift cards are undercharged
risks.explanation: The payment service expects an amount in cents, but this change sends the gift card’s listed value directly. A $25 gift card could charge only 25 cents. Customers could receive far more value than they paid, causing direct losses. Convert dollar values to cents before charging, or store gift-card prices in cents.

risks.title: Retries can double-charge buyers
risks.explanation: The protection against doing the same thing twice uses a newly random code each time. If a customer retries after a slow or failed response, the payment service sees a different purchase and can charge again. Use one stable purchase reference across retries.

questions_for_developer: Where is each issued gift card and its remaining balance saved, so the recipient can redeem the code later?
good_news: The payment result is checked before the code is returned.
